articles.title: GTA 6's Jason and Lucia Actors Break Silence to Celebrate Release
articles.summary: Image Courtesy of Rockstar Games Out of all the secrets Rockstar Games kept close to its chest regarding Grand Theft Auto 6, the identities of its two main actors were among the most closely guarded mysteries. Now that the game is finally out, the two actors behind Jason and Lucia have taken off their metaphorical balaclavas and spoken to the […]
articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google Out of all the secrets Rockstar Games kept close to its chest regarding Grand Theft Auto 6 , the identities of its two main actors were among the most closely guarded mysteries. Now that the game is finally out, the two actors behind Jason and Lucia have taken off their metaphorical balaclavas and spoken to the public.

Dylan Rourke and Manni L. Perez — Jason and Lucia, respectively — put out a joint Instagram post confirming their involvement with the critically acclaimed open-world game.

"Years witnessing the hardest working and most skilled artisans game making has to offer," reads the post. "We are truly honored to collaborate on this worldwide testament to human creativity, ingenuity, and sheer willpower. So much learned and so much to learn, keep fighting for what you love, stay humble. See y'all in Leonida."

View this post on Instagram While Rourke has been acting since 2013, this is his first video game role. Perez also started professionally acting the same year, but this is her second video game role; she was also "Clubber 2" and "Blackjack Dealer" in Grand Theft Auto 5 , making for one massive promotion. Neither of them post online very often, so their digital footprints are limited and don't contain many hints. As comical musician "Weird" Al Yankovic confirmed , there were non-disclosure agreements attached to the project, meaning those involved broadly couldn't confirm their roles. Their follower counts have grown considerably, though, as Perez now has about 434,000 followers on Instagram, while Rourke has around 122,000.

Lucia's actor was confirmed just prior to this Instagram announcement in a strange way. The nominees for the 2026 Game Awards came out on November 17th , which had Perez up for best performance in GTA 6 . It didn't say who she was playing, although, despite official confirmation, it was pretty obvious. Some also saw this as peculiar because it was one day before review embargoes lifted and two days before launch. However, it was clear judges who were playing GTA 6 during the secretive review period gave her the nod .

But some have been on this trail for years now. Most recently, Perez hosted a livestream in October where she was avoiding comments about GTA 6 . Various internet sleuths in 2024 also noted how Rourke and Perez were likely the two leads, which came after a lot of cross-referencing and social media-powered investigations. Others had an inkling the year prior, pointing to various similarities between Perez and Lucia. The corkboard full of red string had some failed leads, but some were entirely on the money, despite how tenuous the connections seemed at the time.

What do you think of Manni's and Dylan's performances? Let us know in the comments.

articles.title: I'm Loving Netflix's Win The Mall (And Haley Baylee), But There's One Thing I'd Like To See More Of
articles.summary: I can't be the only one who's ever wondered what it would be like to spend a night in the mall.
articles.content:
Spoiler alert! This story discusses the ultimate winners of the reality competition series Win the Mall, now available with a Netflix subscription .

When you move 10 teams of two contestants into a shopping mall to compete for a $1 million grand prize, it feels like you should have a plan to incorporate the mall as much as possible. Part shopping spree and part social strategy, players are dropped into a real mall, but the fake storefronts make it challenging to fully utilize the mall itself, leaving it all to feel a bit disconnected at times.

Surprisingly, one of the highlights of Win the Mall is TikTok creator-turned- host Haley Baylee , who is truly delightful. She’s a likable host who can wear anything and look like she’s on a runway, but she also never takes herself too seriously, being goofy when she needs to be and taking on a more serious persona while tempting contestants with possible game advantages.

Burns said of the film: “Having grown up a working-class kid on Long Island, I wanted to explore what I saw as a growing crisis facing working families today. articles.content:
Google , the parent company of YouTube , has responded to backlash resulting from a YouTube video shared to Russell Brand 's account where he claimed he is innocent while in prison via a statement read by his wife, Laura Brand.

“So Russell has asked me to read something to you today,” the actor's wife said at the start of the video, before looking to a notebook to read her husband’s message. “Beloved brothers and sisters in Christ, God bless you for your support. As you know, I am not guilty for the offenses I have been jailed for, so something strange is happening.” blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-article-mid-article-uid0' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["mid-article1","mid-articleX","mid","mid-article"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-article") .addSize([[300,250],[2,2],[300,251],[620,350],[2,4],[4,2],[320,480],[620,366],[300,450],[4,4],[300,251]]) .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; }); Related Stories Business Emma Chamberlain Returning to YouTube With Original Series 'What Are You Waiting For?' (Exclusive) News Over 400 U.K. Industry Figures Demand End to "Culture of Open Secrets" After Russell Brand Trial

In a statement shared with BBC News , Google said it was "aware of the new content and our teams are investigating," adding, "We suspended Russell Brand's channel from the YouTube Partner Program in September 2023. The channel has not been able to monetise on YouTube since then."

BBC News also reported that Google declined a request from the Ministry of Justice to remove the video, saying none of its rules had been broken.

Brand was sentenced to 10 years and six months in prison after being found guilty of rape and sexual assault last Monday. The trial lasted four weeks at Southwark Crown Court, with the jury finding him guilty on one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault (he was found not guilty on two other rape charges and not guilty of attempted indecent assault).

His message, delivered by his wife in the YouTube video, drew criticism, with Britain’s Justice Secretary Alex Norris calling the broadcast of a statement from Brand while he is behind bars “completely unacceptable.” blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-dsk-tab-mid-article2-uid1' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["mid","mid-article2","mid-articleX"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-article2") .addSize([[300,250],[300,251],[620,350],[2,4],[4,2],[320,480],[620,366],[300,450],[4,4]]) .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; });

“Prisoners are rightly banned from making statements that cause distress to victims,” Norris wrote on X. “This is being urgently investigated, and I expect action to be taken if he is found to have broken the rules.”

Elsewhere in the YouTube video, Laura read the rest of Brand's statement, saying, "The good news is that Christ is with us when we choose him, and I do. I am incarcerated in HMP Littlehey. Little as in small, and hey as in, ‘Hey, I’m in the biggest sex offenders prison in Europe.’ The good news is that I have already seen that the staff here are strong, they are kind, and they are dedicated. And as for my fellow prisoners, I now know that I am in no position to judge anyone.”

“I don’t know which other men here are not guilty, and the ones that are, they are people that Christ died to save, like you and me. Let us all love, pray for, and forgive one another as God forgave us. Please support my treasured wife and family. I feel your prayers. Your brother in Christ, Russell,” the remarks concluded.

On Monday, a spokesperson for U.K. Prime Minister Andy Burnham called his message “clearly appalling” and said it was being “urgently investigated,” per Reuters .

At the time of publication, Brand and Laura's YouTube video is still available to watch on the website and has accumulated 950,000 views.

articles.title: 'American Doctor' Director on Her Powerful Gaza Doc: "I Wanted to Do Something"
articles.summary: Poh Si Teng spent 22 years as a journalist and documentary facilitator before a calling to chronicle life and death in Gaza hospitals led to her directorial debut.
articles.content:
"I know the film is called American Doctor , but it's not actually about the American doctors," Poh Si Teng told The Hollywood Reporter at the recent SCAD Savannah Film Festival , referencing the three American physicians — one Jewish, one Palestinian and one Zoroastrian — who are documented in her film as they volunteer at hospitals in Gaza amid the ongoing war there. "It's about their relationships with the Palestinian doctors. This is how we bring it back to the United States."

American Doctor , which premiered at Sundance in January and was released by Watermelon Pictures in August, was a selection of the SCAD Savannah Film Fest’s celebrated Docs to Watch sidebar. As a result, Teng participated in a Q&A following a screening of it for a capacity crowd at the SCAD Museum of Art — which you can watch above — and was also one of 10 directors of outstanding 2026 docs who appeared on the fest’s Doc to Watch Panel . Related Stories Movies Ron Howard Wasn't Sure He Was the Right Director for 'Avedon'; This Is What Changed His Mind SCAD Savannah Film Festival 'Cookie Queens' Director Says Girl Scout Cookies Were "A Delicious Way In" to a Larger Conversation (Video)

Born in Malaysia but now based in the United States, she had never directed a feature film prior to American Doctor . She had worked as a cameraperson for AP, a reporter for the New York Times , a documentary commissioner for Al Jazeera, a studio executive for ABC and a grants director for the International Documentary Association. But then she felt a calling. blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-dsk-tab-mid-article2-uid1' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["mid","mid-article2","mid-articleX"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-article2") .addSize([[300,250],[300,251],[620,350],[2,4],[4,2],[320,480],[620,366],[300,450],[4,4]]) .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; });

"For a long time, I guess for 22 years of my life, I just never felt that my voice as a director was needed," she explained. "I thought it would be a better use of my time and my skills to support other directors. But when the genocide happened, and seeing colleagues of mine at Al Jazeera being targeted and executed, I wanted to do something. I thought maybe it was time."

Sporting a shirt proclaiming "HOSPITALS SHOULD NOT BE TARGETED," she recounted her first impressions of the three American doctors: "When I met them I thought, 'You couldn't be more different. How do you work with each other? How is it possible?'" These were among the questions that led her to try to raise funds to make a documentary. But she quickly found that few institutions were willing to financially support a documentary about the current turmoil in the Middle East.

So she emptied her savings account of $150,000, rallied additional support from a wide range of artists, musicians and activists, and assembled a team of people hailing from eight different countries to film over 50 days spread between the Christmases of 2024 and 2025. She herself could not enter Gaza, so she recruited local filmmakers, who were suffering under the strain of the Israeli blockade of their city, to capture life and death in and around area hospitals.

The film opens with the Jewish-American doctor, Dr. Mark Perlmutter, chastising Teng for her hesitancy to include in the film a photograph of children killed by an Israeli airstrike. She recalled, "Mark set the tone for what the film was going to be, and there was no turning back after that." Henceforth, she did not hesitate to use the material that her team captured — horrifying, inspirational and everything in between — to show and tell a story that few others have documented in such an up-close and personal manner. blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-thr-article-mid-articleX-uid2' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["btf","mid-articleX","mid"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-articleX") .addSize([[300,250],[300,251],[620,350],[320,480],[620,366],[300,450],[4,4]]) .setLazyLoadMultiplier(2) .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; });

Still, it was important to Teng that the film be narratively engaging, so she found structural "points of inspiration" from sources like The Pitt , Chernobyl and The Babadook .

Her conclusion: "If you see 'the other' as your own — if we saw Palestinians as we would see ourselves — we would be more willing to fight for them, especially when it has everything to do with our taxpayer money being used to harm them."

articles.title: Judge Weighs Whether To Allow Kennedy Center To Proceed With Closure Plan
articles.summary: A federal judge said that he will issue a ruling "as soon as I can" as to whether the Kennedy Center can proceed with its plan to close the arts complex for two years for renovations, amid fears that President Donald Trump ultimately will move to demolish the 55-year-old arts complex. U.S. District Court Judge […]
articles.content:
A federal judge said that he will issue a ruling "as soon as I can" as to whether the Kennedy Center can proceed with its plan to close the arts complex for two years for renovations, amid fears that President Donald Trump ultimately will move to demolish the 55-year-old arts complex.

U.S. District Court Judge Christopher Cooper issued an injunction earlier this year that barred the center from closing unless its board conducted a more thorough analysis of its impacts on programming and other operations. The judge also ordered that Trump's name be removed from the complex, with a tarp now covering the front facade after crews removed the lettering to comply with the order. blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-dsk-tab-mid-article1-uid0' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["mid-article1","mid","mid-articleX","mid-article","300x251"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-article") .addSize([[2,2],[300,250],[620,350],[300,251],[501,282],[3,3],[2,4],[4,2],[620,366]]) .exemptFromSleep() .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; }); Related Stories Legal Grand Trump Accomplishment: POTUS Defeats NYT Move To Toss $15B 'Lucky Loser' Defamation Suit News CBS And Paramount+ To Air Next Kennedy Center Honors

The Justice Department, representing the center, is seeking to lift the injunction, arguing that the board vote in August and September to close the center sufficiently examined all of the options, citing a report from Delta Consulting Group. The report concluded that a two-year closure would be much less expensive than keeping the center open during construction, a process that would take four years. "The court contemplated the exact course of action the center took here," William Jankowski, attorney for the DOJ, told the judge.

An attorney for Rep. Joyce Beatty (D-OH), an ex officio board member of the center who is challenging the board's actions, argued that, despite the third-party Delta analysis, the board still has not considered the impact of a closure on such things as fundraising and programming.

Nathaniel Zelinsky, Beatty's attorney, said that the board "keeps rubber stamping the same decision." Trump, who is the board chairman, announced the closure plan in February, but Beatty's legal team has claimed that the decision was not motivated by the renovation, but to mask the embarrassment of a drop in revenue after Trump's name was added to the center's official moniker.

Zelinsky also pointed to another analysis conducted by real estate firm, which showed that a four-year renovation plan that kept the center open would be far less costly than the Delta analysis. He said that the board never were given the JLL report before their August vote, but Jankowski told the judge that it still led to the some conclusion in recommending a two-year closure. blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-dl-mid-article-inject2-uid1' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["mid-article2","mid-articleX","mid-article","mid","300x251"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-article2") .addSize([[300,250],[300,251],[620,350],[2,4],[4,2],[620,366]]) .exemptFromSleep() .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; });

The center itself has had scant major programming since July, and the sprawling main building has been off limits to the public since September. The center says that the closure is temporary due to safety concerns, after a portion of the indoor ceiling plaster collapsed following rainstorms, as well as concerns of deterioration of supports for exterior soffit panels.

Meanwhile, the center is going ahead with its annual Kennedy Center Honors, but in an alternate venue: The Capitol One Arena. The event is scheduled to take place on Dec. 7 and air on CBS on Dec. 27. The center also plans to proceed with the Mark Twain Prize, an annual ceremony honoring comedians and humorists, next year, Jankowski told the judge.

Trump has stirred concerns over demolition of the center after he raised the prospect in social media posts. He also was photographed on Air Force One in September reviewing a poster board that featured the lettering, "Kennedy Center DEMOLISHED."

While the DOJ attorney argued that Trump's remarks are not relevant to whether to lift the injunction, the judge still expressed concerns. In September, he ordered that he be given at least a 30-day notice before any such drastic changes be made to the center.

Norm Eisen , who also is representing Beatty, told reporters that they were trying to prevent a scenario like what happened to the White House East Wing, which Trump ordered demolished last year to make room for a new ballroom, and the East Potomac Golf Course, where the National Park Service abruptly cut down hundreds of trees on a site that the president wants to remake into championship links.

"The most important takeaway: There is no question in my mind that this judge, under any cirumstances, is going to allow the demolition of the Kennedy Center, just that East Wing or East Potomac Golf Course wrecking ball scenario," Eisen said.

articles.title: With Elon Musk And Skydance Taking Over, I Have Mixed Feelings About Star Trek’s Future
articles.summary: There's a lot to unpack about this big move.
articles.content:
Word is out that Elon Musk has invested a significant amount of money in Skydance, making him part-owner of the newly merged studio alongside David Ellison. With headlines suggesting the company may sell DC Studios and make other changes, I'm most concerned and have my eye on what the plan is for Star Trek .

Ellison had a history with Star Trek before becoming head of the studio that owns it. Skydance helped co-produce both Star Trek: Into Darkness and Beyond alongside Paramount when they were separate studios, and he was on the record as a card-carrying Trekkie.

Elon Musk's entry into Star Trek puts another alleged Trekkie at the top of Skydance's ladder, which could propel moves into happening sooner rather than later. For those who don't know, Musk is actually a canon figure in the universe, having been directly mentioned by Gabriel Lorca as one of the great minds of humanity. Despite his various movie and film appearances , Musk has never appeared in Trek .

He's also preached about recreating Star Trek in real life via his SpaceX company, but has simultaneously butted heads with other fans in interpreting what the series is about. We saw that when Starfleet Academy came out, and he openly joked about the show having obese actors and people wearing eyeglasses .

articles.title: Spider-Man’s Darkest Storyline Just Made His Most Iconic Power Deadlier than Ever

Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google Spider-Man has a whole host of iconic powers, from sticking to walls to backflipping like nobody else, but there's no debate that his most unique and interesting power is definitely his Spider-Sense. This preternatural ability lets Peter detect any danger before it reaches him or those around him, and that both keeps him safe and gives him an unmatched edge when he gets into a fight. It's a power that's so ingrained in everything Spider-Man does that it almost becomes invisible, but is always felt. It also has one of the most iconic signifiers in all of comics, immediately telling the audience everything they need to know.

However, even this spectacular power is completely different in the Midnight Universe. This dark new reality has completely reimagined Marvel's most iconic characters. For Spider-Man , that means that his great power now comes with great monstrosity, as the spider that bit him turned him into a creature that is no longer human . This has affected every part of his character, but the biggest shift we saw in Midnight Spider-Man #2 is that his Spider-Sense doesn't just warn him about danger, but takes him over to actively dispatch it.

Given that he transformed into a horrible monster from the spider fusing onto his chest, Peter didn't bring his signed Oscorp contract to Felicia, which landed her in some hot water. She took two of Oscorp's bruisers to his house to find him, but realized how horrible things were when Gargan happened upon what was left of Uncle Ben. Then Peter crawled down from the wall and begged Felicia for help. The goons tried to blast him, but Peter's new instincts kicked in and he went on the offensive. His Spider-Sense forced him to attack , and he did it with relentless abandon, literally ripping the two men apart before diving out the window.

This Peter obviously has no experience in combat. He's probably never even been in a fight before, but here he rushed forward and killed two people without hesitation. Importantly, he didn't attack Felicia, as he didn't register her as a threat. This new Spider-Sense carries a much, much stronger response, tapping into his fight response instead of his flight. This Peter rushes into danger instead of pulling away from it, and it can even override his mind. We know that Peter was hardly aware of what happened because he was practically a walking zombie after he escaped. This is a total rework of how his Spider-Sense works, bringing it closer to the monstrous ideal of this universe.

Before he even officially became Spider-Man, Peter had already killed two people, which his mainline counterpart would never do. The two guards in question weren't just throwaways, either, as they were called Gargan and Rodriquez. Those happen to be the names of Scorpion and Tarantula, and given that one had his face removed and the other parted ways with the vast majority of his organs, it's safe to say that they are dead. This comic has gone out of its way to show that nobody is safe in this new reality, and with a literal beastly side that can take over Peter and kill whoever it deems a threat, it's clear that these are far from the last bodies Peter will put in the ground .

Still, this doesn't mean that this is the last we'll see of these two. It's entirely possible that Doc Ock will use his horrific science to resurrect them, as they've come into contact with Peter and could have been changed in some capacity. Either way, Peter has a long, hard war ahead of him, and none of his nightmare villains are going to be willing to walk away with a few lumps on their heads. They will be corporate monsters created for the sole purpose of capturing or killing him, and no law will stop them.

A huge part of this storyline is definitely going to be Peter drawing a line between what he considers his monstrous new reality and the humanity he can't afford to lose. He'll be forced to either come to terms with killing or force himself to constantly be in control. Either way, he'll have to confront the monster that lives inside of him, both literally and metaphorically. Aunt May, who seems to have left Uncle Ben in this world, could prove to be his last connection to humanity and pull him out of the abyss. Spider-Man is going to have to become something more, or else he'll just be another monster.

What do you think of this change in how Peter's Spider-Sense works? Let us know in the comments below!

The actor, who was 86 at the time of his passing, died on Wednesday, October 28th in Los Angeles after what was described as a “brief and poignant journey with Alzheimer’s […]
articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google Last month, the world of entertainment was dealt a tragic blow with the death of legendary Star Trek and X-Men star Sir Patrick Stewart . The actor, who was 86 at the time of his passing, died on Wednesday, October 28th in Los Angeles after what was described as a “brief and poignant journey with Alzheimer’s Disease and Lewy Body Dementia.” Now, the beloved actor’s death certificate has been issue and confirms the conditions as well as offers additional details.

According to TMZ, Stewart died from Alzheimer’s disease and Lewy body dementia as had previously been reported. The certificate specifically details cardiopulmonary arrest and a neurocognitive disorder with Lewy body — Lewy body dementia, which is a progressive form of dementia that affects not just memory and thinking but movement as well. Other details of the official death certificate also include that Stewart’s remains underwent a process called alkaline hydrolysis, more commonly known as water cremation. It’s a form of cremation that uses water and chemicals rather than high heat and flames.

I went in there really anticipating that was my last tribal. I was like, "I'll just take my time. Let me make and savor the most out of this tribal." It was a real long tribal. When you decided to flip, how much of it was chasing the extra million dollars and how much of it was feeling like, well, I have nothing left to lose.

I couldn't give a wally about that extra $1 million. I couldn't even believe I made it this far in the game to begin with. Honestly, I'm thankful for Devin for making it crystal clear I was going home. It gave me clarity. I'm either going to go out with a bang or I'm going to get a vote without. What do I want?

We saw you scrambling before tribal and getting some mixed responses. Who did you feel you could really count on? Did you have a true number one?

I didn't really have a true number one to be honest. I think that's a product of Exile Island. I came in on day four. People already have their alliances. Am I the only one out there looking at Sharonda like, "Hello? Look at this, she's a threat!" She has mad aura. What's something the audience didn't get to see from your game that you really wish had made the edit?

I can tell you something that I'm glad didn't make the edit. When I was on Dina Beach and I was pooping my pants, I pooped everywhere. I was sleeping, pooping my pants in my sleep. Me and Linnea, we slept next to each other and I was literally pooping in my sleep next to her and it wasn't pretty. They rightfully wanted me out of the game just for that reason alone. The fake idol necklace you revealed right before Jeff snuffed your torch. Do you still have it?

I have it, yeah. It's my pot idol. My pot idol necklace. I got creative out there, I had a million different tricks up my sleeve, and if I had survived this coin flip, I would have had to put them to use because the target would have been on me without a doubt. That would have been a lot of fun so I'm sad I didn't get to do all that. I just had so much fun. I really wanted to embrace thinking outside the box.

I really just want to inspire other people, future players who go. I think it's better to go out early and go out swinging and have fun and do amazing things because a lot of people want to wait until the merge to play and I think that ends up being one of the biggest regrets of a lot of people. Is there anything else about your Survivor experience you want to share that you haven't told anybody yet?

I got rejected from 51, actually. I got a "no" and then I was in this waiting zone. Maybe I was going to get accepted for 52 so I just decided to remove Survivor from my head. I didn't watch any episodes, didn't practice fire, didn't do nothing. Then I'm at Coachella with my wife and I get a call from casting and they're like, "We want you for 51. In two days." And I'm like, what?! What I wore on the island was actually my Coachella outfit. I had no backup clothes or anything like that, and I had that Blood Idol (ring) with me.

I feel like it set a cool tone for the rest of my game. I kind of felt like an alternate in a way, like I'm not even really supposed to be here. I just was literally just plucked last minute, so let's have feckin' fun. Let's go give it a crack. Honestly, that was kind of a real cool part of my Survivor journey. articles.title: Streaming Ratings: Rough Week for Original Series, 'From' Remains No. 1 Overall
articles.summary: 'Love Is Blind' is the top original show, but the bar is lower than it's been in more than two years.
articles.content:
Netflix's Love Is Blind led the original series chart in Nielsen's streaming ratings for the week of Nov. 2-8. But that's not saying a whole lot — it was a very soft week for original streaming shows.

On the acquired series chart, however, From put up more big numbers. The sci-fi/horror series led the overall rankings for a third straight week .

Love Is Blind' s 691 million minutes of viewing time were enough to lead the original series top 10, but that total is the lowest for the top original show in more than two years. The last time the No. 1 original was lower was in early August 2024, when The Boys had 662 million viewing minutes. The top 10 originals as a whole totaled 4.95 billion minutes of watch time, down 21 percent from the previous week. blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-article-mid-article-uid0' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["mid-article1","mid-articleX","mid","mid-article"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-article") .addSize([[300,250],[2,2],[300,251],[620,350],[2,4],[4,2],[320,480],[620,366],[300,450],[4,4],[300,251]]) .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; }); Related Stories TV Streaming Ratings: 'From' Dominates an Otherwise Quiet Halloween Week TV 'Dancing With the Stars' Scores Season Best Ratings With Grammy Night

Nobody Wants This (559 million minutes) and The Diplomat (545 million) finished second and third among original series.

The overall top 10 was down week to week as well, but not by as much (13 percent, from 9.03 billion to 7.84 billion minutes). From tallied 1.69 billion minutes of viewing on Netflix (the show originates on MGM+), nearly doubling the 857 million minutes for the second-place show, Grey's Anatomy .

articles.title: Steven Spielberg Gently Pitched Christopher Nolan The Movie Idea I Think Fans Have Been Wanting
articles.summary: This follow-up makes all too much sense.
articles.content:
I don't know how you follow a $1.8 billion trip through Greek mythology , but Steven Spielberg apparently has an idea. Christopher Nolan is still taking a victory lap for The Odyssey , one of the biggest hits on the 2026 movie schedule , and the Jaws director just floated a follow-up I'd pay good money to see. The way he brought it up made me laugh, too. Even Hollywood legends know how to suggest another movie without sounding too pushy.

I love how politely Spielberg slid that into the conversation. It's the cinematic equivalent of complimenting somebody's enormous Thanksgiving dinner and then asking what they're making next year. He even followed it up by insisting there was no pressure. Nolan, understandably, joked that Spielberg seemed to be speaking for Universal Pictures. Spielberg admitted the studio would probably appreciate it, but he was interested himself.

Nolan has already explained why he chose The Odyssey . He considers The Iliad more grounded, while the later poem's monsters and stranger adventures offered something he hadn't seen done the way he envisioned. That doesn't mean he couldn't change his mind, especially after his latest movie has reportedly earned more than $1.8 billion worldwide.

articles.title: GTA 6 Removes "Iconic" Prostitutes Feature, and Fans Are Angry
articles.summary: Unlike in previous Grand Theft Auto games, players can't hire prostitutes in GTA 6, and this has proven to be one of the biggest talking points of launch week, at least on social media. This is the first Grand Theft Auto game in the 3D era, starting in 2001 with GTA III, which introduced prostitutes […]
articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google Unlike in previous Grand Theft Auto games, players can't hire prostitutes in GTA 6 , and this has proven to be one of the biggest talking points of launch week, at least on social media. This is the first Grand Theft Auto game in the 3D era, starting in 2001 with GTA III , which introduced prostitutes to the series. Since then, they have been in GTA: Vice City, GTA San Andreas , GTA 4 , and GTA 5 . Going into the release of Grand Theft Auto VI , there was no word of this content being removed, making it a surprise for fans of the series. And it's not a surprise many like.

While many Grand Theft Auto players, if not the majority, are not very bothered by the change from Rockstar Games, there are plenty who. To this end, many of the top posts right now on the GTA 6 Unmoderated Reddit page are about this topic, including the very top post.

Not only are Grand Theft Auto fans unhappy that the feature has been removed, but they also claim it's emblematic of the rest of the game, which limits player freedom compared to previous installments, especially when it comes to romance.

"Removing prostitutes from the game makes no sense at all," reads the title of one of the top posts on the aforementioned Reddit page over the last 24 hours. The post continues, "It’s been an iconic feature in the franchise for a long time, but they suddenly decide to scrap it because Jason has to stay loyal to Lucia. Did we just forget that Michael was able to pick up hookers and cheat on his wife in GTA 5 ? It’s supposed to be an unhinged game where anything can happen.

There are many of these posts not just on Reddit, but across the Internet. It's indeed odd that Rockstar Games allows players not to romance Jason and Lucia, yet doesn't let them have other romantic opportunities. You're either locked into the romance or locked into nothing. Rockstar Games has its official explanation , but its official explanation doesn't actually explain a lot. It effectively boils down to not undermining and harming the Bonnie-and-Clyde-esque story that is central to the game, but in the process, it undermines and harms other elements of the series.

This ties into a larger problem with the game, which is that the realism and immersion it puts on a pedestal is often fundamentally at odds with the over-the-top and zany DNA of the series. It worked in Red Dead Redemption 2 because Red Dead Redemption is more grounded, slow-moving, and not as chaotic. To this end, GTA 6 feels far more like RDR2 than any other previous GTA game in many ways.

All of that said, and as always, feel free to leave a comment or two letting us know what you think. Was this the right call by Rockstar Games?

Lance Broadway , a former MLB pitcher turned actor who appeared in Marvel's Agents Of S.H.I.E.L.D., Lucifer and the 2013 film Olympus Has Fallen , among others, has died unexpectedly. He was 43.

Broadway was found dead Tuesday, November 17, in an apartment complex stairwell in Dallas, TX, according to the Dallas County Medical Examiner. The cause of death is pending autopsy results.

articles.content:
Hollywood has spent a good many years trying to adapt British cult classic TV series The Prisoner into a feature film.

Now, however, a producer and a streamer are taking a ride on the penny-farthing back to the original medium.

Amazon Studios has picked up the rights to The Prisoner for a modern take on the series. Angry Films’ Susan Montford and Don Murphy , lifelong fans of the 1967 series who secured the rights, will executive produce, as will Philippe Maigret and Lucianne Papon of ITV, the company which originally distributed the show. blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-article-mid-article-uid0' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["mid-article1","mid-articleX","mid","mid-article"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-article") .addSize([[300,250],[2,2],[300,251],[620,350],[2,4],[4,2],[320,480],[620,366],[300,450],[4,4],[300,251]]) .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; }); Related Stories TV Mariko Tamaki Writing Sexy Vampire Thriller 'Royal Blood' for Skybound, Image Comics (Exclusive) Lifestyle T-Mobile Introduces T-Mix, an Innovative Phone Plan That Lets You Choose What's Included

The original series was a blend of sci-fi, spy craft, and psychological drama set against the paranoia and existential angst of the Cold War at the time. Patrick McGoohan starred as an intelligence agent who is kidnapped and awakens in a remote town known as the Village. Like all the residents, his name is stripped from him and he becomes known only as Number Six. McGoohan spends the series squaring off against Number Two and Number One, not knowing whom he can trust in the town as he tries to escape.

articles.title: Mariko Tamaki Writing Sexy Vampire Thriller 'Royal Blood' for Skybound, Image Comics (Exclusive)
articles.summary: Rossi Gifford is drawing the ongoing series that will debut early next year.
articles.content:
Mariko Tamaki grew up reading the vampire stories by author Anne Rice and became enthralled by the mix of horror and brooding romance.

“I've always loved a heartfelt monster story, and to me she is the queen of the soulful vampire,” the award-winning graphic novel author and creator said via email to The Hollywood Reporter .

Now Tamaki, who has spent the last several years working on DC’s YA graphic novels and is known for her queer coming-of-age story Laura Dean Keeps Breaking Up with Me , will channel some of that love into her own romantic vampire comic book series. She is set to write Royal Blood , an ongoing original horror series from Skybound and Image Comics. blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-article-mid-article-uid0' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["mid-article1","mid-articleX","mid","mid-article"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-article") .addSize([[300,250],[2,2],[300,251],[620,350],[2,4],[4,2],[320,480],[620,366],[300,450],[4,4],[300,251]]) .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; }); Related Stories TV Sam Reid Plays Bloodsucking Rock Star in 'The Vampire Lestat' Trailer From AMC TV AMC Cancels 'Talamasca: The Secret Order' After One Season

Tamaki is working with artist Rossi Gifford ( Batman: Bad Seeds – Streets of Gotham ) on the series, with the duo acting as co-creators along with Glenn Geller, Skybound’s president of TV.

Colorist Miquel Muerto (an apt name for someone who also works on Something is Killing the Children ) and letterer Becca Carey ( Exquisite Corpses ) are on also part of the creative team for the comic, which is due to arrive in shops and digital platforms on Feb. 24, 2027. The book is intended for mature readers.

Hearts will skip, and many will stop entirely, in this story that Geller described as “Shakespeare with fangs.” Royal Blood is centered on a prince named Oliver, who is struggling to understand his place in the royal family, and a vampire, Charlotte, who was sent to destroy the royal family. Tamaki called it as “a sexy spy story, a vampire story, and an impossible love story.” blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-dsk-tab-mid-article2-uid1' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["mid","mid-article2","mid-articleX"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-article2") .addSize([[300,250],[300,251],[620,350],[2,4],[4,2],[320,480],[620,366],[300,450],[4,4]]) .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; });

The initial idea of the series came from Skybound’s Geller, who posited, “What if a vampire spy infiltrated the royal family by seducing the prince?” Geller came up with the concept, title and main character names and showed it to his Skybound colleagues. Skybound Editorial loved the idea and wanted to make it a comic, reaching out to Tamaki, whom they thought would be a perfect fit given her track record.

Tamaki has gained a strong reader following thanks to a body of work that focuses on relationships, identity, and coming-of-age stories, LGBT or otherwise. Her graphic novel Laura Dean won the 2019 Harvey Award for best children or young adult book and was nominated for the Harvey for book of the year. It won three Ignatz Awards and three Eisners, including one for best writer and best publication for teens. More recently she wrote DC’s YA graphic novel I Am Not Starfire as well as the mini-series Zatanna: Bring Down the House .

For Royal Blood , Tamaki pitched a more fleshed out version of the idea and wrote a few scripts. Gifford was then brought in as artist, adding to what became the final form of the series. All three are working together on the ongoing series.

Tamaki listened to Annie Lennox's "Love Song for a Vampire” plenty while writing the comic. The song appeared Bram Stoker’s Dracula , Francis Ford Coppola’s adaptation of perhaps the most famous vampire story of all time. It’s a movie she loves and notes the costumes by Eiko Ishioka as a standout. blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-thr-article-mid-articleX-uid2' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["btf","mid-articleX","mid"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-articleX") .addSize([[300,250],[300,251],[620,350],[320,480],[620,366],[300,450],[4,4]]) .setLazyLoadMultiplier(2) .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; });

Like the Rice novels and the Coppola movie, this comic is intended to have an undercurrent of passion running through it.

“It is so sexy, I can't even tell you,” said Tamaki. “It is sooo sexy. I wrote it a little sexy and then Rossi Gifford made it sooo sexy.”

Gifford is a Toronto-based artist and character-designer who is coming off of working on DC’s Batman: Bad Seeds – Streets of Gotham . Tamaki and Skybound found a smoldering aspect to her work that made her the choice to draw the series.

“With Mariko’s work, which I’ve followed for years, at its heart, we have all the ingredients for a compelling series: engaging characters, a thrilling plot, horror, drama and a spicy love story,” said Gifford in a statement.

Royal Blood will be the latest title in Skybound’s line of horror comics that famously began with The Walking Dead . This year it published Corpse Knight , written by The Conjuring franchise director Michael Chaves, and continues to put out re-imaginings of iconic horror properties with the licenses of Creepshow and the Universal Monsters line.

articles.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Almost Had a Very Different Baby Groot, and You Can Now Own the Strange Original Design
articles.summary: The Walt Disney Company Before there was Baby Yoda, there was another movie character capturing the hearts of moviegoers back in 2017. While the character made his debut as a huge, old walking talking tree - with a very limited vocabulary - after a self-sacrificing moment in Guardians of the Galaxy, he returned as a small sapling ready to […]
articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google Before there was Baby Yoda, there was another movie character capturing the hearts of moviegoers back in 2017. While the character made his debut as a huge, old walking talking tree - with a very limited vocabulary - after a self-sacrificing moment in Guardians of the Galaxy , he returned as a small sapling ready to grow again over the course of several movies. That character is Groot, a part of the Marvel superhero team whose importance is often overlooked for his comical iterations of "I am Groot" in response to everything, who became Baby Groot at the end of the first movie and appeared in said form throughout the second adventure for Star Lord, Gamora, Drax, Rocket and their ever-changing and expanding group. But a new auction is giving fans the chance to own an original design for the character by effects master Phil Tippett and it is very different to the one we thankfully got.

Being sold by Heritage Auctions , this lot features a sculpted maquette of Groot's second form following his "death" in Guardians of the Galaxy . Instead of the cute and strangely cuddly plant-like being, Tippett's proposed design is captured in this piece is a grotesque "old man" Groot with almost pained expression and long spindly limbs. Although the character does have a Groot feel about it, it has a haunted quality that really would not have allowed retailers to stock up on cute cuddly toys and merchandise with its face on. The maquette is made of Magic Sculpt clay, painted in brown to make it look like it is made of wood. The piece is finished off by coming with its own terracotta plant pot with clay "soil" to make it looks like it is actually rooted into the container. The piece is certainly something that could be a talking point as part of any collection, and at the moment it is selling for what seems like a steal at $1,000. Whether it remains at that level is yet to be seen, but if so, then someone will get a great deal.

While Groot is usually involved in the comical side of the MCU, he is a character that has been involved in some of the most pivotal moments the Guardians have faced . In their first outing in 2014, Groot protects the team from being killed in the final act, enclosing the group in his branches and ultimately sacrificing himself for their survival. At the same time, this act prevented the Power Stone from falling into the hands of Ronan, which could have had consequences long before Thanos was able to finally acquire it before Infinity War . The result of Groot's sacrifice was a small shoot of his own being, which then would grow into Baby Groot by the second movie. Again, this form of Groot became the savior of the day, as his size allowed him to carry explosives to the core of Ego the living planet and destroy the megalomaniacal celestial being.

In Infinity War, a now teenage Groot was once again key in several moments, most prominently during the making of Thor's newly forged Stormbreaker by pulling together the pieces of the weapon and cutting off his own arm to create a handle for the weapon. Without the new ax, Thor would not have been able regain his powers and join the Avengers, even if their battle this time around ended in defeat to Thanos. Although it has not been revealed when the Guardians will return after their third solo outing, their future could depend on the events of Secret Wars . James Gunn previously worked on all Guardians stories and with his tenure as DC Studios CEO now over there is a chance he could return for a fourth movie, but there is just as much a chance that Marvel Studios will take the opportunity to prune the main Guardians group form the roster in Phase 7.

Would the original design of Baby Groot have ruined the character? Should the Guardians return to the MCU? Let us know in the comments.

As NBC marks its 100th anniversary this year, another mainstay of the media landscape is turning 80: book publisher Farrar, Straus & Giroux.

On Monday night, as NBCUniversal CEO Mike Cavanagh hosted a star-studded centennial party at the Rainbow Room atop 30 Rockefeller Plaza, FSG President and Publisher Mitzi Angel presided over her own bash.

The celebration, held at the historic event venue Storied in Chelsea, drew its own share of distinguished guests. While late-night host Jimmy Fallon was among the A-listers at NBC, his Tonight Show drummer, Roots frontman Ahmir “Questlove” Thompson, made a surprise appearance at the FSG gathering, delivering a DJ set. Angel addressed the crowd in attendance to salute the company's durability and make an impassioned case for its mission during a time of cultural transformation.

“We live in an age of algorithms, and algorithms are very good at what can be measured now. Literature works on another timescale, in a place measurement can’t reach. The project was first sparked before the COVID-19 pandemic, which slowed momentum on the making of the film. Now the movie has a theatrical release date set and a growing cast attached to the story.

For everything we know about The Nightingale movie, read on.

When will The Nightingale movie come out?

TriStar first set February 12, 2027 as the release date for the film, but then the adaptation was pushed to March 19 so that it has Easter weekend (March 28) to capitalize on. Who will be in The Nightingale movie?

Sisters Dakota and Elle Fanning , who have been attached to star and produce since the adaptation started gaining traction in 2019, will portray sisters Vianne and Isabelle.

Deadline exclusively reported that Edmund Donovan ( Late Fame ) landed a starring role alongside the sisters in January 2026. Details of his role are under wraps.

Next to join as first reported by Deadline are Mark Rylance  ( The BFG, Ready Player One ) and  Shira Haas ( Unorthodox, Captain America: Brave New World ).

Deadline broke the news of a quartet of castings that round out the film's ensemble: Albrecht Schuch , Douglas Hodge, Gwilym Lee and Vinette Robinson.

What is Kristin Hannah’s The Nightingale about?

The story centers sisters Vianne Mauriac and Isabelle Rossignol, who experience German-occupied France during World War II in their own ways. Vianne, the older sister, is more cautious while Isabelle boasts a rebellious spirit. Michael Morris is directing the film. Dana Stevens ( The Woman King ) wrote the script for the film. Elizabeth Cantillon will produce for The Cantillon Company, alongside the Fannings and Brittany Kahan Ward for the Fanning sisters' production company Lewellen Pictures, and Reese Witherspoon and Lauren Neustadter for Hello Sunshine. The Nightingale was the Reese’s Book Club selection for March 2023. Nicole Brown and Shary Shirazi are overseeing for TriStar Pictures.

TriStar first acquired the film rights in 2015 with Ann Peacock attached to write. Writer-director Michelle MacLaren and co-writer John Sayles were involved in a later iteration, with the Fannings initially boarding to star in a version helmed by Mélanie Laurent from Stevens’ script . At first, the film was set to hit theaters Christmas Day of 2020, and then it shifted a few more times landing on Dec. 22, 2022 , but when the Covid pandemic kept delaying the making of the movie, Laurent stepped back to attend to other projects.

Yes, Kristin Hannah posted at the end of March that the film had started production. Elle Fanning did press for Margo's Got Money Troubles in April before the show's premiere on Apple TV, but she had hinted as had her sister Dakota, that they would start shooting in a few weeks when Deadline spoke with them at SXSW Film Festival 2026.

Deadline also interviewed Lauren Neustadter , President of Film and Television at Reese Witherspoon's Production Company Hello Sunshine while she was on set in Budapest, where the film is shooting.

Director Louis HotHotHot is living up to his name. His feature documentary The Year of the Ghost won Best Film in International Competition Thursday as the 39th International Documentary Festival Amsterdam presented its awards.

The Chinese-born filmmaker, also known as Louis Liu, also won Best Editing in International Competition, sharing that prize with his co-editor Chris van Oers.

The IDFA program says in The Year of the Ghost , HotHotHot “fearlessly turns his camera on his own family… Using archival footage, animation, and unflinchingly candid conversations, Louis HotHotHot explores how modern Chinese history and misogyny affect the lives of women. This intimate family portrait unfolds into a compelling story about the status of women and changing family culture in China.” blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-dsk-tab-mid-article1-uid0' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["mid-article1","mid","mid-articleX","mid-article","300x251"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-article") .addSize([[2,2],[300,250],[620,350],[300,251],[501,282],[3,3],[2,4],[4,2],[620,366]]) .exemptFromSleep() .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; }); Related Stories Documentary IDFA Announces Winning Projects In Forum Section, With Prizes Worth More Than €30,000 Documentary 'NAZA' Team Sticking To Plan To Release Shattering Documentary On The Guardian Website Within Weeks -- IDFA

“The jury was astonished by this work of singular artistic vision exploring deep family dynamics and connections, set against the wider societal forces and gender constraints inherited across generations,” wrote jury members Barbara Orlicz-Szczypuła, Hania Mroué, Katy Léna N'diaye, Oscar winner Laura Poitras, and Luuk Bouwman. “Told with bold honesty, a rare attention to detail, cinematic curiosity, and love.”

Separately, The Year of the Ghost won Best Dutch Film, earning a €5,000 prize.

The Special Mention for International Competition went to Hazara Town by Khadim Dai. Scroll for the full list of awards.

The IDFA Award for Best Directing (worth €5,000) in the International Competition went to Joël Richmond Mathieu Akafou for Lonan Tché .

The jury wrote, “Through its deeply attaching characters and the subtitle proximity the filmmaker established with them, the film depicts two overgrown kids in their quest for a dream they might never reach, elevating them to almost mythical figures, enduring their human condition.” blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-dl-mid-article-inject2-uid1' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["mid-article2","mid-articleX","mid-article","mid","300x251"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-article2") .addSize([[300,250],[300,251],[620,350],[2,4],[4,2],[620,366]]) .exemptFromSleep() .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; });

Best Cinematography in the International Competition went to Bardi by Tala Hadid, with cinematography by Tala Hadid.

In the Envision Competition, which IDFA considers to be of equal importance to International Competition, Best Film was awarded to Riccardo Giacconi for Memories of Lightning . That award also comes with a €15,000 cash prize.

In the feature documentary, “Thirty-year old freelance radio journalist Sibilla travels to a village in Le Marche, central Italy. She plans to make an audio documentary about a shocking event that took place there in 1982, but the village is now little more than a ghost town – earthquakes and an artificial lake have destroyed much of it,” reads the IDFA program description. “Still, she tries to capture memories to create a soundscape of the past with her microphone.”

Jury members for the Envision Competition included Firouzeh Khosrovani, Hélder Beja, Hicham Khalidi, Isabel Pagliai, and Jonathan Perel. They wrote, “A studio, a village, a hill. A device that renders irrelevant the distinction between what is real and unreal, that exercises precise control over what is said and what is left unsaid, that stretches time and hunts down stories. A film that captures the silence of things falling, like distant flashes of lightning that are sure to herald the storm.”

Sibilla Scinti Roger, the protagonist of Memories of Lightning , won the award for Outstanding Artistic Contribution. Best Directing (worth €5,000) in the Envision Competition was awarded to Yuula Benivolski for The Black Box Is Orange .

The Special Mention for Envision Competition went to Memories by Anna Falguères.

all that appears solid is built on blood , directed by Izdihar Afyouni and Gelare Khoshgozaran, won the IDFA Award for Best Short Documentary, which comes with a €5,000 cash prize.

“In a world saturated with images of violence, this short film interrogates what images can hold when representation becomes impossible,” said the jury, comprised of Ana Bravo-Pérez, Diana Toucedo, and Yaser Kassab. “Through abstraction, fragmentation, grain, texture, and the material transformation of the film image, documented atrocities are displaced from their conventional modes of representation. The image becomes matter: a site of rupture, disturbance and resistance, where memory exceeds the limits of visibility and what can be shown.”

A Special Mention in the IDFA Competition for Short Documentary went to Six Weeks, 3 Days, and All the Years Before by Ankita Gusain.

The IDFA DocLab Award for Immersive Non-Fiction went to Michał Stankiewicz for Being in You . The award is accompanied by a €5,000 cash prize.

“The winner proposes a new way of perceiving the relationship between the protagonist and the viewer: a new immersive point of view in which the digital protagonist and the physical viewer melt together into one,” observed jurors Blake Kammerdiener, Natalie Paneng, and Roel Wouters. “Through a tender exploration of life and death, this project invited us to see how VR can be a tool to memorialize while also bringing a sense of embodied presence.”

The Special Mention for the IDFA DocLab Competition for Immersive Non-Fiction went to Shifting Connections by Tungyen Chou.

Director Ant Hampton won the IDFA DocLab Award for Digital Storytelling with All the Downtime , earning a €5,000 cash prize. blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-dsk-tab-mid-articleX-uid2' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["mid-articleX","mid-article","btf","300x251"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-articleX") .addSize([[300,250],[300,251],[620,366]]) .exemptFromSleep() ; });

“Out of visual noise; slowly, you are instructed how to use your fingers to read a performance through a book, synchronizing multiple temporalities,” said jurors Abel Enklaar, Claudix Vanesix, and Pegah Tabassinejad. “This project gently crosses the borders. It exists in between mediums, crafting a slowly escalating waterfall of cinematic moments drifting up from the pages. The work invites us to see the increasing entanglements between technocapitalism, precarious labor conditions, automation of human work, disregards of natural ecosystems, and the new warlords of corporate fascism.”

The Special Mention for the IDFA DocLab Competition for Digital Storytelling went to Plum Road Tea Dream by Samuel Baidoo.

Along with the Special Mention for International Competition, Hazara Town won two awards: Best First Feature, which comes with a €5,000 prize, and the FIPRESCI Award chosen by international film critics (FIPRESCI jurors included Hrvoje Pukšec, Loeke de Waal, and Paola Casella).

articles.title: IDFA: 'The Year of the Ghost' and 'Memories of Lightning' Win Amsterdam Doc Fest Awards
articles.summary: 'Hazara Town' is also among the documentaries honored at the 39th edition of the Dutch festival.
articles.content:
The Year of the Ghost and Memories of Lightning are the winners of the top awards at the 38th edition of the International Documentary Film Festival Amsterdam ( IDFA ), unveiled at a ceremony held at the Dutch city’s Eye Filmmuseum.

The Year of the Ghost from director Louis HotHotHot, a co-production between the Netherlands and China, won the IDFA Award for best film in the international competition section, along with two additional honors.

Like in his debut feature Four Journeys , the filmmaker turned his camera on his own family, prompted by the death of his father. "Due to COVID restrictions, the filmmaker cannot make it to China in time to say goodbye," reads a synopsis. Once reunited with his mother and sister, he films them "as they struggle to find a new way to live." blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-article-mid-article-uid0' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["mid-article1","mid-articleX","mid","mid-article"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-article") .addSize([[300,250],[2,2],[300,251],[620,350],[2,4],[4,2],[320,480],[620,366],[300,450],[4,4],[300,251]]) .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; }); Related Stories TV CBS Inks New Deal to Air Kennedy Center Honors THR Spotlight It Girl India Amarteifo's Queen's Gambit

"The jury was astonished by this work of singular artistic vision exploring deep family dynamics and connections, set against the wider societal forces and gender constraints inherited across generations," the jury said. "Told with bold honesty, a rare attention to detail, cinematic curiosity and love."

Meanwhile, the IDFA Award for best film in the fest's Envision Competition, along with another honor, went to Riccardo Giacconi for Memories of Lightning , a France-Italy co-production. The film follows radio journalist Sibilla, who travels to a village in central Italy to make an audio documentary about a shocking murder that took place there in 1982, but the village is now little more than a ghost town. "Still, she tries to capture memories to create a soundscape of the past with her microphone," reads a synopsis. "Little by little, the story emerges of a horrific murder that is part of her family history. The victim, a 14-year-old girl, was Sibilla’s aunt."

Said the jury: “A studio, a village, a hill. A device that renders irrelevant the distinction between what is real and unreal, that exercises precise control over what is said and what is left unsaid, that stretches time and hunts down stories. A film that captures the silence of things falling, like distant flashes of lightning that are sure to herald the storm." blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-dsk-tab-mid-article2-uid1' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["mid","mid-article2","mid-articleX"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-article2") .addSize([[300,250],[300,251],[620,350],[2,4],[4,2],[320,480],[620,366],[300,450],[4,4]]) .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; });

In other honors, the IDFA award for best first feature was bestowed upon Hazara Town by Khadim Dai. It also won another honor and a special mention.

Hazara Town is named after a neighborhood in the Pakistani city of Quetta, which got its name because it is home to so many members of the Hazara ethnic group. What do Disney Parks, Make-A-Wish, and the Hallmark Channel all have in common? They love making dreams come true, and that’s exactly what happened for one teenage Hallmark movie superfan who has dreamt about being in one of the cable channel’s movies for a very long time.

Both Ceci and her mom got to appear in what is apparently one of the major scenes in the holiday romance film, titled Holiday Ever After: A Disney World Wish Come True . Filming wrapped early this year on what could be Hallmark’s best Countdown to Christmas movie of 2026, but the magic hasn’t stopped for Ceci, who was surprised once again when her entire family was flown back out to Walt Disney World to attend the red-carpet premiere.

All of this is making me more excited for the film! Holiday Ever After: A Disney World Wish Come True centers on Lindsey (Chabert), who plans to spend the holidays at Disney World with her extended family. articles.title: How to Get a 6-Star Wanted Level in GTA 6 and Then Escape From the Cops
articles.summary: Courtesy of Rockstar Games Rockstar has brought back the fabled 6-Star wanted level in Grand Theft Auto 6, giving players an extra tier of notoriety that will pit every bit of law enforcement against them in all-out war. Reaching six stars is almost as hard as staying alive once you obtain it, as it requires you to constantly commit […]
articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google Rockstar has brought back the fabled 6-Star wanted level in Grand Theft Auto 6 , giving players an extra tier of notoriety that will pit every bit of law enforcement against them in all-out war. Reaching six stars is almost as hard as staying alive once you obtain it, as it requires you to constantly commit multiple heinous acts of mayhem in a row without getting killed. Those who do manage to obtain a sixth star will find that there is almost no point of return from it, unless they take drastic actions to stay under the radar until the inevitable.

Technically, there is no escape for having six stars in GTA 6 , as acquiring that status puts the entire region of Leonida against you, turning your whole map into a hostile zone. Unless you get killed, busted, or wasted in any way, you'll keep those six stars, which never fall down into 5-4 through the actions you'd usually do to lower that score. That being said, there are some strategies that can keep you alive during your six-star run, making everything else you do in the game more challenging, but creating a "living on the edge" style of criminal life the usual gameplay of GTA 6 doesn't always offer.

Getting six stars is only possible after you've progressed past the initial steps of GTA 6 's story, as the game doesn't allow you to become too notorious too fast. You have to work your way up the criminal ladder, so to speak, before the authorities will pay enough attention to you to grant you the highest wanted level the game has. However, once you have the right weapons and gear past the game's "tutorial" levels to do some real mayhem, the chance to reach six stars is always available. Much like past Grand Theft Auto games , the easiest ways to raise your wanted level is through deliberate, chaotic violence, rather than just petty crimes.

While you could ramp up your stars one at a time through various robberies, heists, or assaults on the streets, the quickest way to get a 6-Star level lies in killing a cop. Any police officer you kill automatically gets you three stars, sending police to the scene of the crime instantly. Through the police radio, you can hear your crime being called as backup begins to arrive. If you want six stars, stay in the area of the killed officer long enough to be recognized as the guilty party, then either try to escape or fight anyone who comes in to arrest you. There are other ways to get to 3-5 stars really fast in GTA 6 besides murder, including:

Once you have the higher star count you need, you simply need to cause more conflict to get to six. This could mean evading the cops who know your description for 20+ minutes, or using significant firepower to hold off others over a prolonged period of time. For example, you could go into the Mile Zero military base, steal a tank, gain 3-4 stars, then keep shooting enemies to get six stars within ten minutes. This will put you in a ton of danger, as killing different authorities will bring the city's wrath down on your character, but this does start the challenge a lot faster than most methods would allow.

Once you reach six stars, there's no turning back. Normally, wanted levels in GTA 6 are tied to another system in the game called Heat, which represents a regional way police track you through specific areas of the map. When you gain a star in one area, police and military there can link you to crimes that took place in that zone, tying you to events that took place. This could manifest when you rob a store, kill someone, or do something else illegal, and is represented in-game by your wanted stars turning red rather than white. Those with Heat on them will have pressure to play smart, removing evidence and escaping crime scenes to prevent themselves from being identified.

When you have six stars, you have Heat all the time, whether you like it or not. Everyone will know exactly who you are and what you've done, due to the severity of your actions. Tracking evidence hardly matters in this state, as it'll be pretty clear who is the one causing the most chaos on the map after you do enough to be recognized with six stars. While lower stars will only create circular zones of Heat based on where crimes happened, six stars will turn the whole map into an active Heat area, preventing you from fleeing to one place to drop the wanted level.

While your Heat and stars can't go down once you get six stars, there are ways to avoid the pressure that comes with being Leonida's most wanted. Much like with lower stars, you can discard clothing from the scene of a crime, escape hostile forces, and lay low in an attempt to get away. Having both Jason and Lucia in these situations helps, as you can both eliminate more enemies following you with the support you provide to one another. Surviving is the key challenge here, as the full police force and military will be coming after you with everything they got once the 6-Star milestone has been hit.

While long multiplayer runs of GTA 6 on six stars isn't possible yet, the close monitoring from AI-controlled enemies during this state can create an interesting "Hard mode" that's even more difficult on a solo playthrough. There are no cheats to lower your wanted level, so to evade attention, you have to break enemy line of sight and not do any other crimes to disappear. Hiding your weapons can be a good strategy, but since cops and military enemies will be trying to deal with you using lethal force, you may want to have some back up guns. Changing vehicles and destroying evidence through cameras is also necessary to stay alive during this state.

Inevitably, you will be taken down with the highest amount of stars in the game, resetting your wanted level and causing you to lose resources in the process. However, accomplishing any missions or other content in this state is truly impressive, as you will be constantly fighting against impossible odds. For something like Grand Theft Auto 6 , that challenge can be all players need, making a 6-Star wanted level an achievement unlike any others in the game.

How will you try to get six stars for your wanted level in GTA 6 ? Let us know in the comments below!

articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google The story of Henry Cavill's time as Superman will forever be bittersweet for a lot of DC movie fans. Cavill seemed custom-made for the role of Clark Kent/Superman, but director Zack Snyder's Man of Steel (2012) was seen as a divisive introduction to the character. Even though fans generally accepted (if not enjoyed) Cavill as Superman, Snyder's subsequent film, Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice , made things even more divisive – and that's when things got weird.

After years of debacle getting him into a proper Justice League movie, it looked like Henry Cavill was done with the DC Extended Universe franchise for good. Then Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson gave fans the false hope that Cavill was about to enter a whole new era of being Superman, thanks to the now-infamous post-credits scene of Johnson's DC film, Black Adam . Cavill never suited up as Superman after that, but now you can at least get a behind-the-scenes look at the last time he put on the Superman suit to film his Black Adam cameo.

I saw that #HenryCavill was trending so I thought I'd add my connection to him. I've only ever worked with him once & only for about 3 hours. I only shot 1 scene with him, but it was pretty iconic. Would he make a good #jamesbond007 ? Maybe, but he made a brilliant Man of Steel. pic.twitter.com/34NYOYkSr5

Cinematographer Steven Hall posted a fond memory of when he worked with Henry Cavill on Black Adam . In his post he writes "I saw that #HenryCavill was trending so I thought I'd add my connection to him. I've only ever worked with him once & only for about 3 hours. I only shot 1 scene with him, but it was pretty iconic. Would he make a good #jamesbond007 ? Maybe, but he made a brilliant Man of Steel."

Cavill name is one that regularly goes viral on social media, whether it's fans talking about one of the new projects he's attached to ( Voltron, Highlander, Warhammer 40,000 ) or the never-ending debates about his previous roles as Superman or The Witcher protagonist Geralt of Rivia. He's also spent years being regularly mentioned in discussions about the next James Bond, ever since talk of Daniel Craig's successor began. Now Batman actor Robert Pattinson is the new Bond – casting news that has resonated all across the world. While early signs point to fans overwhelmingly approving of Robert Pattinson as James Bond, Cavill's name has once again been dragged up as a popular alternate choice. That's led these deeper looks back at his time as Superman and how it went awry.

The current future of DC Universe movies is unclear after major shakeups at DC Studios (following the merger between Skydance and Warner Bros. However, James Gunn still has one last project, his Superman sequel Man of Tomorrow , coming out next year. Actor David Corenswet is fully locked into his role as the DCU Superman, but some fans never give up hope that Henry Cavill will get another chance to suit up and play some alt-universe version (Ultraman) that Corenswet has to face. That's wishful thinking – biut then, we never thought that Black Adam would happen.

You can stream Black Adam and Henry Cavill's other Superman films on HBO Max.

articles.title: New Fallout Game Leaks Ahead of Reveal, but It's Not Anything Fans Would Expect (Update)
articles.summary: Image Courtesy of Bethesda Softworks UPDATE: Bethesda community manager VioletLight confirmed on Reddit shortly after this listing came out that A Wasteland Full of Cats is indeed a real game and will support real pets in the Dallas area. They didn't reveal much else, however, more information is coming "soon." The article as it initially ran continues below. The Outer […]
articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google The Outer Worlds developer Obsidian Entertainment's upcoming Fallout and the Fallout 3 and New Vegas remasters are seemingly not the only Fallout games in production. According to a classification board rating, there is a new Fallout video game coming out, but it's straying pretty far from the series' RPG roots.

As spotted by the Fallout subreddit , a listing for A Wasteland Full of Cats popped up on October 22nd on the Australian Classification Board , which rates media for the titular island country. It might not immediately seem like a Fallout game based on the title, but the listing itself makes it rather explicit. The description calls it a hidden object game where players find cats inside of a Vault.

"One day there is an accident in the Vault and all of the cats who live there escape out into the Wasteland," reads the description. "It is up to you with the help of some NPCs you meet along the way to find them and return them to the Vault."

This listing notes it will have 14 locations, 33 rooms, and a vault with recognizable elements from the Fallout franchise with puzzles that won't be required for players to hit the credits. Bizarrely, the post also says players will fight radroaches (huge irradiated cockroaches) at the end.

The description ends by saying it is a partnership between developer Devcats and publisher Bethesda. "Zenimax Australia Pty Ltd" is also listed as the party that applied for the rating, further casting aside doubt that this is some AI-generated and legally dubious knock-off.

Unsurprisingly, Devcats is known for its cat-related video games. While some have yet to be released, the studio has developed 17 cat-centric games — 18 counting the Fallout game — on various platforms over the last few years, many of which are only a few bucks and have players clicking around environments to find felines. The "Full of Cats" title is also a pretty consistent naming convention for the team, as nine of its games are part of that series. As such, anyone more interested in this inevitable Fallout-branded installment will likely get a decent peek at what's in store for them by looking at any of those aforementioned nine titles.

A Wasteland Full of Cats has yet to be formally announced by Bethesda or Devcats, thus it is not clear what platforms the game is coming to, how much it will cost, and when it is being released. However, it does seem like it will be announced shortly. Not only do listings on ratings board imply an imminent launch, Devcats also teased on November 12th that it was announcing two more games "soon," likely bringing its total cat games up to 19.

It's a odd collaboration, but it is one that appears to be consistent to Xbox CEO Asha Sharma's goals. According to a Bloomberg report, Sharma wants to focus more on the big franchises. A few months later, a Fortune feature noted she even created a new division within Xbox to "centralize and double down on commercial opportunities for top franchises."

This move has come at the cost of many studios and games outside of this focus, as highlighted by Xbox shedding off teams like Double Fine, Arkane Lyon, Ninja Theory, and Undead Labs, all of which mostly worked on lesser-known franchises. But seeing as though many cut developers were working at places like id Software and Halo Studios , it doesn't seem like working on a big franchise makes any developer safe from Xbox's job-cutting hatchet.

Will you play a cat-themed, hidden object game in the Fallout universe? Let us know in the comments.
